name: Shackleton rim
program: legacy site (crater scale)
why_it_matters: Near-continuous sunlight on the rim next to permanently shadowed ice; Chang'e-7 / ILRS and ESA studies also target this area
source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (crater centre and diameter)

name: de Gerlache rim
program: legacy site (crater scale)
why_it_matters: Sunlit rim near Shackleton; holds the 2022 and 2024 de Gerlache Rim Artemis regions
source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (crater centre and diameter)

name: Haworth rim
program: legacy site (crater scale)
why_it_matters: Large cold trap with sunlit rim segments; Artemis III region 'Haworth' sits on it
source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (crater centre and diameter)

name: Faustini rim
program: legacy site (crater scale)
why_it_matters: Cold trap with high-albedo (possible ice) floor; Artemis 2022 region 'Faustini Rim A'
source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (crater centre and diameter)

name: Mons Mouton summit
program: legacy site (crater scale)
why_it_matters: Flat-topped mountain with good sun and Earth view; VIPER target area
source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (crater centre and diameter)

name: Shackleton floor (shadow)
program: legacy site (crater scale)
why_it_matters: Permanently shadowed crater floor (ice, ~50 K); contrast site, not in the overall ranking
source: USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (crater centre and diameter)
